## 7.6 Forecasting Weekly Sales at Walmart

This exercise is taken from Chapter 7 of *Practical Time Series Forecasting with R* [@shmueli2018practical].

The data in WalmartStore1Dept72.csv is a subset from a larger datasets on weekly department-wise sales at 45 Walmart stores, which were released by Walmart as part of a hiring contest hosted on kaggle.com [@walmart_kaggle]. The file includes data on a single department at one specific store.

The fields include:

-   Date - the week
-   Weekly_Sales - sales for the given department in the given store
-   IsHoliday - whether the week is a special holiday week
-   Temperature - average temperature in the region
-   Fuel_Price - cost of fuel in the region
-   MarkDown1-5 - anonymized data related to promotional markdowns that
-   Walmart is running. MarkDown data is only available after Nov 2011, and is not available for all stores all the time.
-   CPI - the consumer price index\
    Unemployment - the unemployment rate

We are interested in creating a forecasting model for weekly sales for the next 26 weeks.

```{r 7-6-data}
ws1d72 <- read_csv(here::here("data/WalmartStore1Dept72.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
    mutate(Date = mdy(Date)) |> 
    as_tsibble(index = Date)
```
